title: Soil Sensor Check-In Gap
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture and greenhouse sensors (`plant:sensor`), aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plant:sensor
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by plant
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>12
| sort - hours_since
description: Finds plant sensors that have stopped reporting, which is often how dead batteries or drowned probes first reveal themselves.
value: A missing moisture reading can be just as harmful as a dry reading if it causes you to trust a stale dashboard.
implementation: Forward plant-sensor data through MQTT or HEC; alert when a sensor exceeds its expected reporting gap.
visualization: Table of plants by hours since last sensor report.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which plant sensors have gone silent long enough that you should not trust their old readings anymore.
